title: Illinition
summary: ILLINI'TION, noun [Latin illinitus, illinio, to anoint; in and lino, to besmear.] A thin crust of some extraneous substance formed on minerals. It is sometimes disguised by a thin crust or illinition

inlines.v: ILLINI'TION, noun [Latin illinitus, illinio, to anoint; in and lino, to besmear.] A thin crust of some extraneous substance formed on minerals. It is sometimes disguised by a thin crust or illinition of black manganese.
